tier1.text: Each gluteus medius moves the thigh out to the side, a movement called abduction. Of the gluteus muscles in the buttock, the gluteus medius is the medium-sized one. The gluteus medius lies under the gluteus maximus and over the gluteus minimus.

sentences.text: Each gluteus medius moves the thigh out to the side, a movement called abduction.

quotes.quote: One of the three gluteal muscles on the lateral surface of the pelvic bone that abducts and rotates the thigh.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

quotes.quote: abduction: movement in the coronal plane that moves a limb laterally away from the body
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Of the gluteus muscles in the buttock, the gluteus medius is the medium-sized one.

quotes.quote: For the buttocks, the size of the muscles influences the names: gluteus maximus (largest), gluteus medius (medium), and the gluteus minimus (smallest).
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The gluteus medius lies under the gluteus maximus and over the gluteus minimus.

quotes.quote: The gluteus maximus is the largest; deep to the gluteus maximus is the gluteus medius, and deep to the gluteus medius is the gluteus minimus, the smallest of the trio
